epistemic_findings.critical_conclusion: Historical catalog and checkpoint timestamps reflect manual operator or scheduled batch invocation offset (24.7s - 46.8s), NOT broker delivery latency. The broker's first candle availability distribution is completely uninstrumented in existing data.
